# Outbound Delivery Manifest and Pre-Trip Load Verification
Sunnyside Fresh Foods Distribution Hub - Dock Bay 4

## Load & Route Information
- Driver: Paul Moreau
- Route ID: RTE-048
- Date: 10/14/2026
- Vehicle: 2024 Freightliner M2 Box Truck (Unit 18)
- Dispatch Supervisor: Keiko Quinn
- Staging Checker: Hannah Ellison

## Cargo Manifest Reconciliation Table
| Item Code | Description | BOL Unit Count | Physical Count | Temp Spec | Physical Temp | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DR-102 | Whole Milk 1-Gal (4/cs) | 45 | 45 | 34°F - 38°F | 36°F | Match |
| DR-205 | Sharp Cheddar Blocks (12/cs) | 30 | 30 | 34°F - 40°F | 37°F | Match |
| PR-410 | Washed Spinach Totes | 25 | 25 | 33°F - 36°F | 35°F | Match |
| PR-415 | Sliced Strawberries Flats | 40 | 38 | 32°F - 36°F | 34°F | Discrepancy |
| BV-301 | Cold Pressed Orange Juice | 50 | 50 | 34°F - 38°F | 36°F | Match |

## Driver Verification Notes
- Verified cargo securement bars in two positions across rear pallets.
- Refrigeration unit set point confirmed at 35°F and running continuous cycle.
- Reconciled physical counts against bill of lading line items; noted that strawberry flats are complete with zero count variance.
- Dispatch clearance approved after signature sign-off.

## Driver Sign-Off
- Driver Paul Moreau confirms load inspection.
- Departure authorization logged at 05:45 AM.

errors.quote: noted that strawberry flats are complete with zero count variance
errors.explanation: The cargo manifest reconciliation table explicitly lists line item PR-415 (Sliced Strawberries Flats) with a BOL count of 40 and a physical count of 38, categorized as a Discrepancy (short by 2 flats). Claiming the strawberry flats are complete with zero variance directly contradicts the table data.
errors.fix: noted a 2-case shortage on strawberry flats against the manifest

errors.quote: Driver Paul Moreau confirms load inspection
errors.explanation: Standard pre-trip perishable cargo sign-off requires documenting the recorded reefer bulkhead/cargo hold temperature reading at time of inspection to confirm cold-chain integrity before departure.
errors.fix: Driver Paul Moreau confirms load inspection and cargo hold temp of 35°F
